Script.name: m_dulltracker_main
Script.script:
DULL = DULL or {} DULL.version = "1.2.2" DULL.ids = DULL.ids or { triggers = {}, timers = {} } DULL.ids.triggers = DULL.ids.triggers or {} DULL.ids.handlers = DULL.ids.handlers or {}
local unpack_fn = table.unpack or unpack
function DULL.trim(s) return tostring(s or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end
function DULL.note(msg) cecho("<cyan>[Dull]<reset> " .. tostring(msg or "") .. "\n") end
function DULL.warn(msg) cecho("<tomato>[Dull]<reset> " .. tostring(msg or "") .. "\n") end
function DULL.fresh_line() cecho("\n") end
function DULL.to_bool(value) local v = DULL.trim(value):lower() if v == "y" or v == "yes" or v == "on" or v == "true" or v == "1" then return "y" end if v == "n" or v == "no" or v == "off" or v == "false" or v == "0" then return "n" end return nil end
function DULL.bool_word(value) return value == "y" and "on" or "off" end
function DULL.timestamps_enabled() return not DULL.settings or DULL.settings.timestamp ~= "n" end
function DULL.today_key() return os.date("%Y-%m-%d") end
function DULL.seconds_until_next_day() local now = os.time() local t = os.date("*t", now) t.hour, t.min, t.sec = 0, 0, 0 t.day = t.day + 1 return math.max(60, os.difftime(os.time(t), now) + 2) end
function DULL.reset_session_data() DULL.sessionData = {} DULL.sessionId = tostring(os.time()) .. "-" .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999)) DULL.lastIncrease = {} DULL.sessionDay = DULL.today_key() end
function DULL.configure_paths() if DULL.paths_configured then return end local home = (type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" and getMudletHomeDir() or ".") local dir = home .. "/persistence" if type(mkdir) == "function" then pcall(mkdir, dir) end if type(lfs) == "table" and type(lfs.mkdir) == "function" then pcall(lfs.mkdir, dir) end DULL.persistence_dir = dir DULL.state_file = dir .. "/dull_tracker_state.lua" DULL.db_file = dir .. "/dull_tracker.db" DULL.paths_configured = true end
DULL.defaults = { channel = "echo", report = "y", highlight = "y", mode = "normal", sessionMode = "manual", timestamp = "y", valueColor = "@W", labelColor = "@D", blabelColor = "@C", debug = "n", }
DULL.default_auto_reports = { cp = "y", quest = "y", gq = "y", dbl = "y", lvl = "y", pup = "y", timed = "y", }
DULL.report_activity_order = { "cp", "quest", "gq", "dbl", "lvl", "pup", "timed" }
DULL.report_activity_labels = { cp = "campaign", quest = "quest", gq = "gq", dbl = "double", lvl = "level", pup = "pup", timed = "timed", }
DULL.report_activity_aliases = { cp = "cp", campaign = "cp", campaigns = "cp", q = "quest", quest = "quest", quests = "quest", gq = "gq", gqs = "gq", globalquest = "gq", globalquests = "gq", ["global-quest"] = "gq", ["global-quests"] = "gq", dbl = "dbl", double = "dbl", doublexp = "dbl", ["double-xp"] = "dbl", lvl = "lvl", level = "lvl", levels = "lvl", pup = "pup", pups = "pup", timed = "timed", timer = "timed", all = "all", }
DULL.default_gags = { normal = { xp = "n", gold = "n", tax = "n", loot = "n", sac = "n", rare = "n" }, focused = { xp = "y", gold = "y", tax = "y", loot = "y", sac = "y", rare = "n" }, }
DULL.aard_color_map = { k = "<black>", r = "<maroon>", g = "<green>", y = "<ansi_yellow>", b = "<navy>", m = "<purple>", c = "<turquoise>", w = "<light_gray>", D = "<gray>", R = "<red>", G = "<ansi_light_green>", Y = "<yellow>", B = "<blue>", M = "<magenta>", C = "<cyan>", W = "<white>", }
function DULL.aard_to_cecho(str) local s = tostring(str or "") s = s:gsub("@@", "\001") s = s:gsub("@x(%d%d?%d?)", function(num) local n = tonumber(num) if not n or n < 0 or n > 255 then return "" end if n < 16 then local basic = { "000000", "800000", "008000", "808000", "000080", "800080", "008080", "c0c0c0", "808080", "ff0000", "00ff00", "ffff00", "0000ff", "ff00ff", "00ffff", "ffffff" } return "<#" .. basic[n + 1] .. ">" end return "" end) s = s:gsub("@([krgybmcwDRGYBMCW])", function(code) return DULL.aard_color_map[code] or "" end) s = s:gsub("@%-", "~") s = s:gsub("@[^@]", "") s = s:gsub("\001", "@") return s .. "<reset>" end
function DULL.strip_aard(str) local s = tostring(str or "") s = s:gsub("@@", "\001") s = s:gsub("@%-", "~") s = s:gsub("@x%d?%d?%d?", "") s = s:gsub("@.", "") s = s:gsub("\001", "@") return s end
function DULL.disp_val(val) return (DULL.settings.valueColor or "@W") .. tostring(val or "") end
function DULL.disp_lbl(val) return (DULL.settings.labelColor or "@D") .. tostring(val or "") end
function DULL.disp_blbl(val) return (DULL.settings.blabelColor or "@C") .. tostring(val or "") end
function DULL.serialize_lua(value, indent) indent = indent or 0 local t = type(value) if t == "number" or t == "boolean" then return tostring(value) end if t == "string" then return string.format("%q", value) end if t ~= "table" then return "nil" end local pieces = {"{"} local next_indent = indent + 2 for k, v in pairs(value) do local key if type(k) == "string" and k:match("^[%a_][%w_]*$") then key = k else key = "[" .. DULL.serialize_lua(k, next_indent) .. "]" end table.insert(pieces, "\n" .. string.rep(" ", next_indent) .. key .. " = " .. DULL.serialize_lua(v, next_indent) .. ",") end table.insert(pieces, "\n" .. string.rep(" ", indent) .. "}") return table.concat(pieces) end
function DULL.merge_defaults() DULL.settings = type(DULL.settings) == "table" and DULL.settings or {} for k, v in pairs(DULL.defaults) do if DULL.settings[k] == nil then DULL.settings[k] = v end end if DULL.settings.channel == "default" then DULL.settings.channel = "echo" end if DULL.settings.showinfo ~= nil then DULL.settings.showinfo = nil end
DULL.autoReports = type(DULL.autoReports) == "table" and DULL.autoReports or {} for activity, default in pairs(DULL.default_auto_reports) do DULL.autoReports[activity] = DULL.to_bool(DULL.autoReports[activity]) or default end
DULL.gags = type(DULL.gags) == "table" and DULL.gags or {} for mode, defaults in pairs(DULL.default_gags) do DULL.gags[mode] = type(DULL.gags[mode]) == "table" and DULL.gags[mode] or {} for gag, value in pairs(defaults) do if DULL.gags[mode][gag] == nil then DULL.gags[mode][gag] = value end end end end
function DULL.load_state() DULL.configure_paths() local loaded local f = io.open(DULL.state_file, "r") if f then f:close() if type(table.load) == "function" then local into = {} local ok, result = pcall(table.load, DULL.state_file, into) if ok and type(into) == "table" and next(into) ~= nil then loaded = into elseif ok and type(result) == "table" then loaded = result end end if not loaded then local chunk = loadfile(DULL.state_file) if chunk then local ok, result = pcall(chunk) if ok and type(result) == "table" then loaded = result end end end end
loaded = type(loaded) == "table" and loaded or {} DULL.settings = loaded.settings or {} DULL.autoReports = loaded.autoReports or {} DULL.gags = loaded.gags or {} DULL.sessionData = loaded.sessionData or {} DULL.totalData = loaded.totalData or {} DULL.totalStart = tonumber(loaded.totalStart) or os.time() DULL.sessionId = loaded.sessionId or (tostring(os.time()) .. "-" .. tostring(math.random(100000, 999999))) DULL.sessionDay = loaded.sessionDay or DULL.today_key() DULL.saved_timer_starts = loaded.timerStarts or {} DULL.lastReports = loaded.lastReports or {} DULL.merge_defaults() end
function DULL.state_payload() local timer_starts = {} for name, timer in pairs(DULL.timers or {}) do timer_starts[name] = tonumber(timer.start) or os.time() end return { settings = DULL.settings, autoReports = DULL.autoReports, gags = DULL.gags, sessionData = DULL.sessionData, totalData = DULL.totalData, totalStart = DULL.totalStart, sessionId = DULL.sessionId, sessionDay = DULL.sessionDay, timerStarts = timer_starts, lastReports = DULL.lastReports, } end
function DULL.save_state_now() if not DULL.state_file then DULL.configure_paths() end local payload = DULL.state_payload() if type(table.save) == "function" then local ok = pcall(table.save, DULL.state_file, payload) if ok then return true end end local f, err = io.open(DULL.state_file, "w") if not f then DULL.warn("Could not save state: " .. tostring(err)) return false end f:write("return ", DULL.serialize_lua(payload), "\n") f:close() return true end
function DULL.schedule_save(delay) if DULL.ids.save_timer then pcall(killTimer, DULL.ids.save_timer) end DULL.ids.save_timer = tempTimer(delay or 1.0, function() DULL.ids.save_timer = nil DULL.save_state_now() end) end
function DULL.open_db() if DULL.db then return true end if DULL.db_checked and DULL.db_available == false then return false end DULL.configure_paths()
local ok, mod = pcall(require, "lsqlite3") if not ok or type(mod) ~= "table" then ok, mod = pcall(require, "lsqlite3complete") end if not ok or type(mod) ~= "table" then DULL.db_checked = true DULL.db_available = false DULL.warn("SQLite unavailable; timer history DB disabled for this session.") return false end
local db, _, err = mod.open(DULL.db_file) if not db then DULL.db_checked = true DULL.db_available = false DULL.warn("Could not open DB: " .. tostring(err)) return false end
DULL.sqlite3 = mod db:exec("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL") db:exec("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL") db:exec([[CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS timer_history ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, timer TEXT NOT NULL, started_at INTEGER, ended_at INTEGER, duration_seconds INTEGER, report TEXT, xp INTEGER DEFAULT 0, gold INTEGER DEFAULT 0, qp INTEGER DEFAULT 0, tp INTEGER DEFAULT 0, practices INTEGER DEFAULT 0, trains INTEGER DEFAULT 0, levels INTEGER DEFAULT 0, pups INTEGER DEFAULT 0, area TEXT, session_id TEXT, details TEXT )]]) db:exec("CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dull_timer_history_timer_end ON timer_history(timer, ended_at)") DULL.db = db DULL.db_checked = true DULL.db_available = true return true end
function DULL.encode_details(details) if type(details) ~= "table" then return "" end if yajl and yajl.to_string then local ok, encoded = pcall(yajl.to_string, details) if ok then return encoded end end local parts = {} for k, v in pairs(details) do table.insert(parts, tostring(k) .. "=" .. tostring(v)) end table.sort(parts) return table.concat(parts, ";") end
function DULL.insert_timer_history(row) if not DULL.open_db() then return false end local stmt = DULL.db:prepare([[ INSERT INTO timer_history (timer, started_at, ended_at, duration_seconds, report, xp, gold, qp, tp, practices, trains, levels, pups, area, session_id, details) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ]]) if not stmt then return false end local OK = DULL.sqlite3 and DULL.sqlite3.OK or 0 local DONE = DULL.sqlite3 and DULL.sqlite3.DONE or 101 local bind_ok = stmt:bind_values( tostring(row.timer or ""), tonumber(row.started_at) or os.time(), tonumber(row.ended_at) or os.time(), tonumber(row.duration_seconds) or 0, tostring(row.report or ""), tonumber(row.xp) or 0, tonumber(row.gold) or 0, tonumber(row.qp) or 0, tonumber(row.tp) or 0, tonumber(row.practices) or 0, tonumber(row.trains) or 0, tonumber(row.levels) or 0, tonumber(row.pups) or 0, tostring(row.area or ""), tostring(DULL.sessionId or ""), DULL.encode_details(row.details) ) local step_ok = false if bind_ok == OK then step_ok = stmt:step() == DONE end stmt:finalize() return step_ok end
function DULL.sql_quote(value) return "'" .. tostring(value or ""):gsub("'", "''") .. "'" end
function DULL.valid_timer_name(timer) timer = DULL.trim(timer):lower() if timer == "double" then timer = "dbl" end if DULL.timers and DULL.timers[timer] then return timer end return nil end
function DULL.normalize_report_activity(activity) local key = DULL.trim(activity):lower() return DULL.report_activity_aliases[key] end
function DULL.should_auto_report(activity) local key = DULL.normalize_report_activity(activity) if not key or key == "all" then return false end return DULL.settings.report == "y" and DULL.autoReports[key] ~= "n" end
function DULL.parse_timer_history_command(cmd) local first, rest = DULL.trim(cmd):match("^(%S+)%s*(.-)$") local timer = DULL.valid_timer_name(first or "") if not timer then return nil end
rest = DULL.trim(rest) if rest:lower():match("^%-h") then rest = DULL.trim(rest:sub(3)) end
local count = 1 if rest ~= "" then if not rest:match("^%d+$") then return nil end count = tonumber(rest) or 1 end return timer, count end
function DULL.query_history(timer, count) timer = DULL.valid_timer_name(timer) if not timer or not DULL.open_db() then return nil end count = math.max(1, math.min(tonumber(count) or 10, 100)) local sql = string.format( "SELECT timer, ended_at, report FROM timer_history WHERE timer=%s ORDER BY ended_at DESC LIMIT %d", DULL.sql_quote(timer), count ) local rows = {} for row in DULL.db:nrows(sql) do table.insert(rows, row) end return rows end
function DULL.query_averages(timer, count) timer = DULL.valid_timer_name(timer) if not timer or not DULL.open_db() then return nil end count = math.max(1, math.min(tonumber(count) or 50, 500)) local sql = string.format([[ SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, AVG(duration_seconds) AS avg_s, MIN(duration_seconds) AS best_s, MAX(duration_seconds) AS worst_s FROM ( SELECT duration_seconds FROM timer_history WHERE timer=%s AND duration_seconds > 0 ORDER BY ended_at DESC LIMIT %d ) ]], DULL.sql_quote(timer), count) for row in DULL.db:nrows(sql) do return row end return nil end
function DULL.comma_value(n) local s = tostring(n or 0) local left, num, right = string.match(s, "^([^%d%-]*%-?%d)(%d*)(.-)$") if not left then return s end return left .. (num:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse()) .. right end
function DULL.split_field(str) local out = {} for part in tostring(str or ""):gmatch("([^_]+)") do table.insert(out, part) end return out end
function DULL.add_to_field(data, fields, amount) if type(data) ~= "table" or type(fields) ~= "table" or #fields == 0 then return end local key = table.remove(fields, 1) if #fields > 0 then data[key] = type(data[key]) == "table" and data[key] or {} DULL.add_to_field(data[key], fields, amount) else data[key] = (tonumber(data[key]) or 0) + (tonumber(amount) or 0) end end
function DULL.sum_field(field) if field == nil then return 0 end if type(field) ~= "table" then return tonumber(field) or 0 end local total = 0 for _, v in pairs(field) do total = total + DULL.sum_field(v) end return total end
function DULL.report_field(field, levels, for_channel) if field == nil then return "" end if type(field) ~= "table" then local val = DULL.comma_value(field) return for_channel and DULL.disp_val(val) or tostring(val) end if (tonumber(levels) or 0) <= 0 then local val = DULL.comma_value(DULL.sum_field(field)) return for_channel and DULL.disp_val(val) or tostring(val) end local keys = {} for k, _ in pairs(field) do table.insert(keys, k) end table.sort(keys) local parts = {} for _, key in ipairs(keys) do local val = DULL.report_field(field[key], levels - 1, for_channel) if val ~= "" then if for_channel then table.insert(parts, DULL.disp_val(val) .. DULL.disp_lbl(key)) else table.insert(parts, tostring(val) .. key) end end end return table.concat(parts, for_channel and " " or " ") end
function DULL.nonzero_child_count(field) if type(field) ~= "table" then return 0 end local count = 0 for _, value in pairs(field) do if DULL.sum_field(value) ~= 0 then count = count + 1 end end return count end
function DULL.report_breakdown(field, levels, for_channel) if DULL.nonzero_child_count(field) <= 1 then return "" end return DULL.report_field(field, levels, for_channel) end
DULL.source_labels = { qp = { cp = "CP", q = "Qs", gq = "GQ", db = "DB" }, tp = { cp = "CP", q = "Qs", gq = "GQ", mob = "Mob", db = "DB" }, count = { kill = "Kills", q = "Quests", cp = "Campaigns", gq = "GQs", lvl = "Levels", pup = "PUPs", dbl = "Double XP" }, }
DULL.count_labels = { cp = "CP", q = "Q", gq = "GQ", kill = "Kills", lvl = "Lvls", pup = "PUPs", dbl = "DXP", }
DULL.source_order = { cp = 10, q = 20, gq = 30, db = 40, mob = 50, kill = 60, lvl = 70, pup = 80, dbl = 90, }
function DULL.source_breakdown(field, labels, include_single) if not include_single and DULL.nonzero_child_count(field) <= 1 then return "" end labels = labels or {} local keys = {} for key, value in pairs(field or {}) do if DULL.sum_field(value) ~= 0 then table.insert(keys, key) end end table.sort(keys, function(a, b) local ao = DULL.source_order[a] or 999 local bo = DULL.source_order[b] or 999 if ao == bo then return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end return ao < bo end) local parts = {} for _, key in ipairs(keys) do table.insert(parts, tostring(labels[key] or key) .. " " .. DULL.comma_value(DULL.sum_field(field[key]))) end return table.concat(parts, " + ") end
function DULL.total_with_sources(field, labels) local total = DULL.comma_value(DULL.sum_field(field)) local sources = DULL.source_breakdown(field, labels, false) if sources ~= "" then return total .. " = " .. sources end return total end
function DULL.clear_gmcp_gain_buckets() for _, name in ipairs({ "sessionData", "totalData", "doubleData", "timedData" }) do local data = DULL[name] if type(data) == "table" then for _, root in ipairs({ "xp", "gold", "qp", "tp", "tr", "pr" }) do if type(data[root]) == "table" then data[root].gmcp = nil end end end end if type(DULL.lastIncrease) == "table" then for _, root in ipairs({ "xp", "gold", "qp", "tp", "tr", "pr" }) do DULL.lastIncrease[root .. "_gmcp"] = nil end end DULL.gmcpMonitor = nil DULL.gmcpContext = nil end
function DULL.counts_segment(field) local keys = {} for key, value in pairs(field or {}) do if DULL.sum_field(value) ~= 0 then table.insert(keys, key) end end table.sort(keys, function(a, b) local ao = DULL.source_order[a] or 999 local bo = DULL.source_order[b] or 999 if ao == bo then return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end return ao < bo end)
local parts = {} for _, key in ipairs(keys) do table.insert(parts, DULL.disp_blbl(DULL.count_labels[key] or key) .. DULL.disp_lbl(": ") .. DULL.disp_val(DULL.comma_value(DULL.sum_field(field[key])))) end if #parts == 0 then return DULL.disp_lbl("[") .. DULL.disp_blbl("Totals") .. DULL.disp_lbl(": ") .. DULL.disp_val("0") .. DULL.disp_lbl("]") end return DULL.disp_lbl("[") .. DULL.disp_blbl("Totals") .. DULL.disp_lbl(" ") .. table.concat(parts, DULL.disp_lbl(" ")) .. DULL.disp_lbl("]") end
function DULL.seconds_to_minutes(seconds) seconds = math.max(0, tonumber(seconds) or 0) return DULL.disp_val(math.floor(seconds / 60)) .. DULL.disp_lbl("m ") .. DULL.disp_val(seconds % 60) .. DULL.disp_lbl("s") end
function DULL.seconds_to_plain(seconds) seconds = math.floor(math.max(0, tonumber(seconds) or 0)) return string.format("%dm %02ds", math.floor(seconds / 60), seconds % 60) end
function DULL.seconds_to_days(seconds) return DULL.disp_val(string.format("%.1f", (tonumber(seconds) or 0) / 86400)) .. DULL.disp_lbl("days") end
function DULL.history_line(row) local ts = tonumber(row and row.ended_at) local report = tostring(row and row.report or "") if not DULL.timestamps_enabled() or not ts or ts <= 0 then return report end return DULL.disp_lbl("[") .. DULL.disp_val(os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", ts)) .. DULL.disp_lbl("] ") .. report end
function DULL.configured_channel() local channel = DULL.trim(DULL.settings and DULL.settings.channel or "echo") if channel == "" then channel = "echo" end return channel end
function DULL.report_cached_history_row(index) index = tonumber(index) if not index then return DULL.note("Usage: click a Dull history row label.") end local row = DULL.historyRows and DULL.historyRows[index] or nil if not row then return DULL.note("No cached Dull history row #" .. tostring(index) .. ". Run a Dull history command first.") end return DULL.report(DULL.history_report_text(row), DULL.configured_channel()) end
function DULL.history_date_tag(row) if not DULL.timestamps_enabled() then return "" end local ts = tonumber(row and row.ended_at) if not ts or ts <= 0 then return "" end return DULL.disp_lbl(" (") .. DULL.disp_val(os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", ts)) .. DULL.disp_lbl(")") end
function DULL.history_report_text(row) local report = tostring(row and row.report or "") local tag = DULL.history_date_tag(row) if tag ~= "" then return report .. tag end return report end
function DULL.echo_history_link(label, index) local channel = DULL.configured_channel() if type(cechoLink) == "function" then local ok = pcall(cechoLink, "<cyan>" .. label .. "<reset>", function() DULL.report_cached_history_row(index) end, "Click to report this row via " .. channel, true) if ok then return end end cecho(label) end
function DULL.echo_clickable_history_report(index, report) report = tostring(report or "") local plain = DULL.strip_aard(report) local label, number = plain:match("^%[([A-Z]+)%s+#(%d+)") if not label then label = plain:match("^%[([A-Z]+):") end if not label then cecho(DULL.aard_to_cecho(report)) return end
local label_pos = report:find(label, 1, true) if not label_pos then cecho(DULL.aard_to_cecho(report)) return end
local number_pos, number_end if number then number_pos, number_end = report:find(number, label_pos + #label, true) end local split_end = number_end or (label_pos + #label - 1)
cecho(DULL.aard_to_cecho(report:sub(1, label_pos - 1))) DULL.echo_history_link(number and (label .. " #" .. number) or label, index) cecho(DULL.aard_to_cecho(report:sub(split_end + 1))) end
function DULL.echo_history_row(index, row) DULL.echo_clickable_history_report(index, row and row.report or "") local tag = DULL.history_date_tag(row) if tag ~= "" then cecho(DULL.aard_to_cecho(tag)) end cecho("\n") end

function DULL.wrap_text(text, width) local words, lines, line = {}, {}, "" for word in tostring(text or ""):gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(words, word) end for _, word in ipairs(words) do if line == "" then line = word elseif #line + #word + 1 <= width then line = line .. " " .. word else table.insert(lines, line); line = word end end if line ~= "" then table.insert(lines, line) end if #lines == 0 then lines[1] = "" end return lines end

function DULL.command(arg) local cmd = DULL.trim(arg) local lower = cmd:lower() local setting_keys = { channel = "channel", report = "report", highlight = "highlight", timestamp = "timestamp", timestamps = "timestamp", valuecolor = "valueColor", labelcolor = "labelColor", blabelcolor = "blabelColor", debug = "debug", } local gag_types = { xp = true, gold = true, tax = true, loot = true, sac = true, rare = true } if lower == "" or lower == "help" then return DULL.show_help("") end local help_topic = lower:match("^help%s+(.+)$") if help_topic then return DULL.show_help(help_topic) end
if lower == "reports" then return DULL.report_auto_report_settings() end local report_activity, report_value = lower:match("^report%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)$") if report_activity then return DULL.set_activity_report(report_activity, report_value) end report_activity = lower:match("^report%s+(%S+)$") if report_activity then if DULL.to_bool(report_activity) then return DULL.set_setting("report", report_activity) end return DULL.show_activity_report(report_activity) end
local timer, hist_n = DULL.parse_timer_history_command(cmd) if timer and lower:match("^%S+%s+%-h") then return DULL.report_history(timer, hist_n) end
local avg_timer, avg_n = lower:match("^avg%s*(%S*)%s*(%d*)$") if avg_timer ~= nil then return DULL.report_averages(avg_timer ~= "" and avg_timer or "pup", avg_n ~= "" and avg_n or 50, "echo") end avg_timer, avg_n = lower:match("^averages?%s*(%S*)%s*(%d*)$") if avg_timer ~= nil then return DULL.report_averages(avg_timer ~= "" and avg_timer or "pup", avg_n ~= "" and avg_n or 50, "echo") end
local session_mode = lower:match("^session%s+(%S+)$") if session_mode == "manual" or session_mode == "auto" then return DULL.set_session_mode(session_mode) end
local report_cmd, report_channel = cmd:match("^(session)%s*(.-)$") if report_cmd then return DULL.report_session(report_channel) end report_cmd, report_channel = cmd:match("^(total)%s*(.-)$") if report_cmd then return DULL.report_total(report_channel) end report_cmd, report_channel = cmd:match("^(double)%s*(.-)$") if report_cmd then return DULL.report_double(report_channel) end report_cmd, report_channel = cmd:match("^(status)%s*(.-)$") if report_cmd then return DULL.status(report_channel) end
report_cmd, report_channel = cmd:match("^(stats)%s*(.-)$") if report_cmd then return DULL.report_stats(report_channel) end report_cmd, report_channel = cmd:match("^(mastery)%s*(.-)$") if report_cmd then return DULL.report_mastery(report_channel) end report_cmd, report_channel = cmd:match("^(instinct)%s*(.-)$") if report_cmd then return DULL.report_instinct(report_channel) end report_cmd, report_channel = cmd:match("^(resists?)%s*(.-)$") if report_cmd then return DULL.report_resists(report_channel) end
timer, hist_n = DULL.parse_timer_history_command(cmd) if timer then return DULL.report_history(timer, hist_n) end
if lower == "xpr reset" then return DULL.reset_rate("xpr") end local rest = cmd:match("^xpr%s+clear%s*(.-)$") if rest ~= nil then return DULL.clear_area_rate("xpr", rest) end rest = cmd:match("^xpr%s*(.-)$") if rest ~= nil then return DULL.show_area_rate("xpr", rest) end
if lower == "gr reset" then return DULL.reset_rate("gr") end rest = cmd:match("^gr%s+clear%s*(.-)$") if rest ~= nil then return DULL.clear_area_rate("gr", rest) end rest = cmd:match("^gr%s*(.-)$") if rest ~= nil then return DULL.show_area_rate("gr", rest) end
if lower == "dps reset" then return DULL.reset_rate("dps") end rest = cmd:match("^dps%s+clear%s*(.-)$") if rest ~= nil then return DULL.clear_area_rate("dps", rest) end rest = cmd:match("^dps%s*(.-)$") if rest ~= nil then return DULL.show_area_rate("dps", rest) end
local mins = lower:match("^timer%s*(%d*)$") if mins ~= nil then return DULL.timed_session_start(mins ~= "" and mins or nil) end if lower == "timer clear" then return DULL.timed_session_clear() end
local one_word = lower:match("^(%S+)$") if one_word and setting_keys[one_word] then local key = setting_keys[one_word] return DULL.note(key .. " is: " .. tostring(DULL.settings[key])) end if one_word == "mode" then return DULL.note("mode is: " .. tostring(DULL.settings.mode)) end
local first_word, rest_words = cmd:match("^(%S+)%s+(.+)$") if first_word then local key = setting_keys[first_word:lower()] if key then return DULL.set_setting(key, rest_words) end end
local mode_value = lower:match("^mode%s+(%S+)$") if mode_value then return DULL.set_mode(mode_value) end
local gag_mode, gag_type, gag_value = lower:match("^(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)$") if (gag_mode == "normal" or gag_mode == "focused") and gag_types[gag_type] then return DULL.set_mode_gag(gag_mode, gag_type, gag_value) end
if lower == "settings" then return DULL.report_settings() end if lower == "gags" then return DULL.report_gags() end if lower == "save session" then DULL.save_state_now(); return DULL.note("Session saved") end if lower == "clear session" then return DULL.clear_session() end if lower == "clear total" then return DULL.clear_total() end if lower == "refresh" then return DULL.status("echo") end if lower == "show" then return DULL.show_variables("session") end if lower == "showtotal" then return DULL.show_variables("total") end if lower == "db" then return DULL.db_status() end
DULL.warn("Invalid command. Try: dull help") end
function DULL.install() math.randomseed(os.time()) DULL.kill_temp() DULL.load_state() DULL.init_runtime() DULL.clear_gmcp_gain_buckets() DULL.auto_clear_session_if_needed() DULL.schedule_session_rollover() DULL.install_triggers() DULL.open_db() DULL.schedule_save(1.0) DULL.note("m_dulltracker v" .. DULL.version .. " loaded. Type 'dull help'.") end
DULL.install()
